Attached: 1 image

Unfolded my iPhone Duo, opened GitHub… and got a phone-sized island floating in a sea of black 🏝️
Not every app got the memo yet: compatibility mode, an expand ↖↘ button and a rotate button, like iPhone apps on the first iPad in 2010. History doesn't repeat, it letterboxes.
Dear devs: size classes, NavigationSplitView, done. The big screen is waiting 🙏
#iPhoneDuo #iOS #SwiftUI #GitHub #Apple #Foldable #IndieDevLife
